candidate_source_operations_not_first_di.operation: LAPSPREP reads rain and snow as radar 3-D hydrometeor fields in kg m-3; zeros invalid cells, clips negative values to zero and applies hydrometeor_scale; under CAP_POLICY=TRANSFER moves excess cloud liquid to rain and ice to snow; converts concentration to dry-air mixing ratio by division by rho; the shadow path writes candidate mapped QR/QS into the WPS arrays.
candidate_source_operations_not_first_di.evidence_class: source-path hypothesis; actual archived pre/post QR/QS at this operation not compared here

candidate_source_operations_not_first_di.operation: Writes rain/snow arrays as WPS QR/QS at pressure levels and a zero surface level; does not itself establish upstream array changes.
